newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian import prices rise in February.
newsitem.headline: Australian import prices rise in February.

text.p: Australian import prices rose 0.5 percent in February from the previous month but remained 4.7 percent below their level of a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.

"While the value of the Australian dollar rose against most other major trading currencies, it continued to fall against the U.S. dollar, leading to an overall increase in the import price index of 0.5 percent in February 1997," the bureau said.
It was the second successive month in which import prices had risen, the bureau's figures showed. They fell in almost every month of 1996.
The annual rate of import-price inflation has risen from a trough of minus 9.7 percent recorded in June and July.
